find_param_config_fields: find all config field paths matching a given suffix recursively in a PyText config object
cast_str_to_type: cast a string value to int, float, bool, list, or dict using type annotations
replace_param_in_config: replace a config parameter by dotted path with automatic type casting from a string value
resolve_optional_type: resolve an Optional type annotation to its inner non-None type argument
is_component_class_check: check if an object is a component class by verifying its class name starts with an uppercase letter
